utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what's going on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center! I heard Jules is bringing a blender, and you can bring small appliances or electronics to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this Saturday? I think I had it on my calendar but then forgot. Do we need to sign up or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal! Are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm planning to bring a few things. Do you happen to have the list of items and locations? I'd like to map out the best route.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh great! I have the list right here—I can share it with you so you can plan your route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I'm excited to bring my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer but I didn't read it too closely. What exactly are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's a community event where people bring broken stuff—appliances, clothes, electronics—and volunteers fix them for free. I'm planning to bring my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. I have a flyer if you want to see the list of items they need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira. I could use a look at that flyer—I'm still catching up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I've got it right here. Let me pull it out for you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, do you have any spare parts or tools we could use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What repair drive? I still haven't seen that list of supplies you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, right — I do have a list! I can share it with you if you want to see what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus! Have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center? It's a great way to get your broken stuff fixed for free.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about it! I'm planning to bring some tools and help out. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's from 10 AM to 4 PM, so plenty of time to bring things in!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Sam, I'm organizing a repair drive. Do you have any broken electronics you'd like to donate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got an old blender that's been sitting around. I'll bring it to the drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, actually, the drop-off is on weekdays after 3:15 PM. Could you bring the blender on Monday instead?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, have we set a date for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4, but I'm still worried we don't have enough supplies organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I've got that in my calendar now. What supplies are we missing? I can maybe pick some up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Maybe we should look at that flyer together—I'm getting mixed up about what's allowed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I think I saw the flyer, but I'm not sure I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, don't worry if you can't make it—I can always drop off your stuff for you! What did you want to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Nell, did you hear about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard! I'm planning to bring my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great, I was thinking of helping out too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: See you Saturday! Also, just a heads up, the repair drive is this Friday evening—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wait, I thought it was Saturday at 3 PM. Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, 9 AM Saturday? I thought it was Friday evening. What's the correct time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, sorry for the mix-up! It's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, starting at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at 10 AM? I'll have to reschedule. Is that definite?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry Eli, I'm not sure of the exact schedule—I just got here too. But Gus is ready to go, so maybe we can just start and see how it goes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Actually, it's this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. I'll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Saturday at 9, got it. Thanks Sam, that clears things up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? What exactly is that supposed to be?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a neighborhood event where volunteers go around fixing things for people—like fences, leaky faucets, that sort of thing. I'm trying to plan the best route to cover all the stops.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'd feel better if I could see a detailed list of what we're fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it starts at 10 AM and goes until 4 PM. Want to meet there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good. I'll be there at 10. Can you help with my brake pads?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo! Are you planning to join us for the repair drive this Saturday? We'd love to have you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, my garage is the drop-off point. I'll be there from 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo! We're glad to have you and your garage as the venue.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Pia, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive on Saturday morning at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was thinking of bringing some tools, but I'm still worried if we have enough supplies organized. Do you know what time it starts exactly?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think it's just Saturday morning, maybe around 10? The flyer didn't give an exact time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I'm not sure I'll be able to make it, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's a shame. I thought it might be fun to help out, but I didn't really read the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, just got a lot on my plate right now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Faye. I'll let people know to bring broken electronics and small appliances to the community center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great idea, Hana! I'll bring my tool kit and be ready to help out after 2 PM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus! That's really helpful. I'll make sure everyone knows you'll be there after 2.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo! Do you have any broken electronics to donate? Just remember drop-off is after 3:15 on weekdays at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got a few old radios and a toaster that needs fixing. I'll bring them by after 3:15 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then! I'll be at the garage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center. You should come, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, I think it's been moved to Sunday – do you have the latest flyer?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, really? I thought it was still Saturday—let me double-check my flyer, but I might have an old one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey, I got a flyer from the grocery store about the repair drive—wanna see the list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the flyer! Yes, let me see it—I keep mixing up what's on the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Here, take a look—everything's right there on the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli! Yes, the repair drive is this Friday evening. Drop-offs start Monday after 3 PM at Faye's garage. I'm also organizing a pickup route if you need one!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Wait, I thought the repair drive was Saturday? Are there two events?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, just one event—Friday evening. The Saturday thing must be a mix-up.
